correctness.rationale: Reconstructed barycentric Reeve-prism horizontal fiber: only one horizontal lattice translate contributes a.e. and vertical interval length 1+mT with T=min(x,1−x,y,1−y). For independent uniform x,y, P(T>t)=(1−2t)^2 on [0,1/2]; a random vertical shift rounds interval occupancy to floor/ceil. Integration gives exact cubic positive-part tails P(N>=k)=(m/6)[(1−2(k−2)/m)_+^3−(1−2(k−1)/m)_+^3], correct support, P(N=1)=2/m−4/(3m²), mean 1+m/6, variance m²/72+1/6−(1−(−1)^m)/(48m²). Independent Fraction integration of tails and moment identities was exact for m=2..35; general proof is integral, not extrapolation. Orbit-volume counting yields unique coverage fraction 4(3m−2)/(m²(m+6)); |N/m−T|<=2/m a.e. proves limit law.
